Xocova (ensitrelvir) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-682235  
Guideline Name 
Xocova (ensitrelvir)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Xocova  
Approval Length 
1 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming requested drug is used for 
post-exposure prophylaxis of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19)  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 1940 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1940 
 
2 - Treatment is initiated within 72 hours following contact with an individual who has COVID-
19  
 
AND 
 
3 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming a negative COVID-19 test 
prior to initiation  
 
AND 
 
4 - Patient is 12 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
5 - Provider has confirmed (via pregnancy test) that the patient is NOT pregnant prior to 
receiving treatment  
 
AND 
 
6 - Females of reproductive potential will use effective contraception during treatment and for 
2 weeks after the final dose  
 
AND 
 
7 - Patient is high-risk due to co-morbidities (e.g., cancer, cerebrovascular disease, CKD 
[chronic kidney disease], chronic lung or liver disease, heart disease)  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
8/3/2026  
New program.
